items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Now this fellow, his name, Seguero. His voice name, I don't know if you forgot it. Well, I think he played with P-Rone.

ctx.x: Must have been a small E-flat bass. Is that what it looks like?

Yeah, it's Alpride. Both of those are small E-flat basses, yeah. Not used to that. Now this fellow, his name, Seguero. His voice name, I don't know if you forgot it. Well, I think he played with P-Rone.
I think we have his picture with P-Rone.
